summary: Ceragon Networks filed a Form 6-K (the non-US equivalent of a routine current report on Form 8-K) announcing management's participation in two November 2026 investor conferences: the 17th Annual Craig-Hallum Alpha Select Conference in New York on November 17 and the 7th Annual Needham Tech Week virtual one-on-one event November 18-20. CEO Doron Arazi and CFO Ronen Stein will hold one-on-one meetings. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or structural terms are disclosed; the filing is an ordinary investor-relations scheduling notice, not a special situation.
